purpose: Machine-readable active project lanes for agent orientation. This file does not authorize production, cloud, deployment, or secret changes.

lanes.name: Subscription Control Plane
lanes.riskBoundary: C/B for repo docs/code; A for production state, tenant state, artifacts, DNS, Nginx, or runtime changes
lanes.purpose: Own subscription authority, Admin/operator actions, opaque artifacts, and stable subscription rendering.
nonGoals: production mutation without Risk A approval

lanes.name: Edge Data Plane
lanes.riskBoundary: A for real node, DNS, Nginx, systemd, production config, tenant, or traffic changes
lanes.purpose: Make production edge nodes replaceable data-plane capacity while preserving provider-neutral identities and rollback paths.
nonGoals: node changes without live inventory and approval

lanes.name: Local Client Adapter
lanes.riskBoundary: B for repo prototype work; A if device credentials, production transport, installer, or runtime activation is introduced
lanes.purpose: Develop a loopback-only Local Edge Agent path that lets Clash/Mihomo keep routing/UI while platform channels evolve behind it.
nonGoals: Server Edge Mesh transport in V1
production remote transport without a separate gate

lanes.name: Validation And CI
lanes.riskBoundary: C for validation docs; B for validation scripts and test changes; not staging or deploy approval
lanes.purpose: Keep local tests, Admin tests/build, GitHub Actions intent, and Aliyun manual CI fallback understandable and reproducible.

lanes.name: Operator Lab / HP Relay
lanes.riskBoundary: Local/operator experiment only unless explicitly promoted through separate design and risk gate
lanes.purpose: Support local path, upstream, and channel-behavior research without confusing it with production or staging.

lanes.name: Server Edge Mesh
lanes.riskBoundary: C for docs/preflight; A for WireGuard install, keys, UDP ingress, service changes, or live mesh validation
lanes.purpose: Plan private edge-to-edge health, management, validation, and recovery paths.
